predicates.name: pair_gate_opposing_listed_positions
predicates.threshold: On the shocked node there exist two listed holders with opposite sign_of_exposure and a position difference above threshold. Day one: any difference, logged.
predicates.role_note: Arming predicate 6, pair form (spec §4.12). Pre-registered test: for shocks where two listed holders held opposing positions on the node, the pair's relative move exceeded either leg's absolute attributable move. If this fails across ten rounds, tide-cancellation is dead and positions are ontology only.

predicates.name: listed_party_position_on_node
predicates.threshold: At least one listed holder has a recorded position on the shocked node and a named carrier exists for the call.
predicates.role_note: PLACEHOLDER for arming predicate 6, single form (t0_candidates.arming_pass_single / listed_party / carrier). Replace wording from v4 §4.3.

positions.source: seed: PO producer (spec §8); scarcity on PO helps a producer

hypotheses.text: For shocks where two listed holders held opposing positions on the shocked node, the pair's relative move exceeds either leg's absolute attributable move.
hypotheses.falsifier: Across ten scored rounds with an opposing listed pair on the node, the pair's relative move does not exceed either leg's absolute attributable move; tide-cancellation is then dead and positions are ontology only.
hypotheses.granularity: pair-level, per shocked node, per scored round; ten-round window

hypotheses.text: When a chokepoint shock unwinds, constraint prices (insurance and freight premia on the constrained route) de-escalate slower than the prices of the cargo that was constrained.
hypotheses.falsifier: A premia-ladder observation in which route insurance or freight premia normalise before, or at the same pace as, the constrained cargo price.
hypotheses.granularity: weekly, per rung of the Hormuz premia ladder (war-risk insurance, tanker freight, cargo)
